task: Review this fictional arbitration clause. Identify the missing information needed before the clause can specify where and how arbitration will take place.
input: Disputes shall be resolved by binding arbitration under the rules of a mutually agreed arbitration provider.

facts.text: The clause does not specify an arbitration venue or seat.
The clause does not name the arbitration provider; it defers to mutual agreement at the time of a dispute.
The packet does not supply a fallback mechanism if the parties cannot agree on a provider.

forbidden_additions: A recommended venue or named arbitration provider.
An assertion about which provider's rules would apply by default.
A fallback clause that substitutes for the missing agreement.
preserve: The identification of the missing venue as one gap.
The identification of the missing named provider as a second gap.
The identification of the absent fallback as a third gap.
